name: Bokura ga Miru no wa Koi no Yume
original_name: 僕らが見るのは恋の夢
source:
She doesn't even know when it started, but she's been seeing the same dream of arguing with someone for a while now. It starts interfering with her daily life, so the protagonist confides in Miyabe, her senior, but...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26364]Freem![/url]]
translation:
她甚至不知道从什么时候开始，她已经连续做了一段与某人争吵的梦了。日常生活开始受到干扰，主人公向前辈宫部吐露心声，但是……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26364]Freem![/url]]
